messages:
cara: Alert: sudden uptick in compat.signature_mismatch after the v1 header tightening. Several tenants tripped fallback and support pinged.
noah: I'm seeing requests where x-client-signature is present but canonicalized differently (hex vs base32). scorer treats as mismatch.
anya: short-term mitigation: add a 'signature_flex' mode that accepts both encodings for scoring and expose a preview on the rollout page showing token-cost delta.
cara: ops wants an immediate safe-action: simulate mode for tenants (shadow) and a throttled auto-revert if fallback_rate > 2% for 10m.
noah: backend: add POST /api/rollouts/preview that returns {current_rate, shadow_rate, flex_rate, quota_delta} (preview traces tagged preview=true). I'll ensure preview doesn't affect alerts.
anya: UX: add a small "Flexible signature" toggle with preview and an auto-revert checkbox. Tooltip: "Allow multiple signature encodings to reduce false incompatibilities during staged deprecations."
ops-bot: created dry-run job for cohort=5% with shadow mode. Monitoring compat.signature_mismatch and preview.quota_delta.
cara: follow-ups: noah -> implement flex scoring + preview endpoint; anya -> UI toggle + auto-revert checkbox; I'll coordinate support notifications. Reconvene in 20m to check metrics.
